Entry (reclaim) and the trap (sweepLow) are already labelled; the target is not. reversalTop is a valid point anchor for liquidity_sweep_bullish (anchors: support, firstTest, sweepLow, reclaim, reversalTop) and is the point price reverses up to — the natural anchor for the target. Marker matches the point-anchor type; place above keeps the label clear of candles. Closes the trade-plan gap with the minimal add.

noAnchorGaps.concept: Stop placed just below the deviation/sweep low
noAnchorGaps.quote: place our stop below the deviation low
noAnchorGaps.why: move liquidity_sweep_bullish exposes no level anchor for a stop. Its only (L) anchor is support (already used for 'range low'); sweepLow is a point, so a level/zone cannot attach there. The stop is a horizontal LEVEL just under the sweep low with no anchor to draw on. The sweepLow marker already labels the deviation, so the location is on-screen, but the stop level itself is undrawable here.
